name: Enzo Hins
tagline: Security research at Virginia's Commonwealth Cyber Initiative. CTFs, blue team, red team, programming competitions and hackathons.
about: CS sophomore at JMU with a cybersecurity focus and a Russian minor. Most of my time goes to competitions, club work and projects.
I started on defense, running a Palo Alto firewall for MACCDC, and moved toward offense. I lean red team now and still like shipping products.

I use agentic AI tools daily and review everything they produce. I built an agent loop that solved the VMI CyberFusion challenges well inside the time limit. I directed AI to build this site and made the design calls.
Math is what draws me to machine learning: linear algebra, calculus, and the theory behind them.
Long term: national security, as a cybersecurity or software engineer or in AI and ML. Open to private and public sector work.
Outside of that: skateboarding and Brazilian jiu-jitsu.
